messages:
emma: Heads-up — AtlasCompute (Luis) wants to run joint perf/W and throughput benchmarks next Wed. They offered dedicated H100 racks and on-site power telemetry. Can eng-ml + eng-runtime confirm what inputs we need?
raj: High level — we need: model set, sequence lengths, batch sizes, quantization modes, and kernel flags. Also exact power-sense points (Idle, 50%, 100%).
sophie: Proposed model suite: gpt-3.5-ish (7B/13B), Llama2-70B, and a T5-style encoder-decoder for rerank. Seq lens: 64, 512, 2048. Batch: 1, 8, 32 (where memory fits).
raj: +1. For throughput vs latency we should report p50/p95 token latency and sustained tokens/s plus perf/W (tokens/s per Watt). Include KV-cache warm vs cold.
olivia: We need legal sign-off on sharing perf numbers before any public mention. Also telemetry: what metrics do we collect and which are allowed to leave the datacenter?
emma: @luis_at_atlas can you confirm their power telemetry granularity and whether they can export per-GPU power traces? Also timeline for their PR/announcement window.
luis_at_atlas: We can provide per-GPU power at 1s granularity and rack-level mains readings. No embargoed PR yet — we'd like to coordinate a joint blog approx 2 weeks after runs. NDA signed already per SOW.
raj: For kernel tuning, we should run two arms: 1) upstream kernels only, 2) vendor-optimized kernels (their tuned cuBLAS/attention ops). We must capture git hashes + env.
sophie: I'll prepare prompts and eval packs for quality regression checks. We should also include a simple decode consistency script (ensure same outputs across kernels within tolerances).
emma: Good. Who can run the initial sweep on our side this week? Need a sanity run to catch config issues before on-site.
raj: I can run the sanity sweep on a cloud H100 fleet Thursday. I'll upload run configs to the shared folder and tag @sophie.
raj: Example bench command (sanity):
```
./run_benchmark --model llama2-70b --seq 2048 --batch 1 --precision fp16 --kernels default --out results/llama2_2048_fp16.json
```
raj: And a perf/W wrapper:
```
./power_monitor --gpu-list 0-7 --out power.csv & PID=$!; ./run_benchmark ...; kill $PID; python compute_perf_per_watt.py results.json power.csv
```
hw-bench-bot: Automated note: Last infra sanity run (internal) passed: 3/3 smoke models completed, no OOMs. Artifacts: s3://redwood-inference/bench/sanity-1719900000
olivia: Please ensure artifacts do not include customer data and that we redact any partner-only IDs before sharing externally.
emma: Plan: raj runs cloud sanity Thu, sophie readies eval packs Thu-Fri, then on-site run with Atlas next Wed. Luis to share rack access doc and contact for on-site ops. After runs, 48h for result analysis + review, then coordinate blog timing.
luis_at_atlas: Sounds good. I’ll send the rack doc and on-site ops contact by EOD. Looking forward to collaborating. :+1:
emma: Thanks all — tagging this thread for follow-ups. If anyone hits blockers ping #eng-runtime or DM me.
